row.notes: myteam-g1: Registers manufacturer-themed My Team bases (myteam_ferrari, honda, mercedes, renault). CORRECTION(V9006): Data loader for a list of My Team vehicle bases: reads list/version/stat_id/file_name/display_name/display_description/engine_stat_id/base_vehicle_stat_id, and a switch on engine id picks myteam_renault/ferrari/mercedes/honda keys. Not simply a register of four manufacturer bases. Callers: census steam 0x2507810. | myteam-guard 2026-11-13: the save loader of the My Team vehicle bases (caller 0x142488290 under Game_SaveData_DeserialiseContainer). For each child of the save's 'list' it reads stat_id (u16, [rsp+0x44]) and file_name (chars at [rsp+0xb8]), resolves file_name in entrants.vehicles with Gdb_Find_RowByLabel (0x1425082f5, found flag not passed) and builds the base's AI config with Sess_Load_VehicleAiConfig (0x142508305) without checking the row, then reads the remaining fields and stores the base with Sess_VehicleTable_EmplaceAt (0x1425098d5). A file_name whose row is gone (an addon's My Team engine base such as myteam_mes_porsche_2026 with the addon off) leaves the row 'Invalid' (index -1) and faults in Sess_Load_VehicleAiConfig+0x2dd (4m7rul dump: row 'Invalid', label myteam_mes_porsche_2026). Guard sites: site_Game_MyTeamVehicleBases_AiConfigLoad, site_Game_MyTeamVehicleBases_NextBase.  Bosseboissss (1.9.19, MES on, crash at the boot profile load on the title screen, +0x452 form): dump shows base 3 (stat id 3) on 'myteam_mes_alfa_romeo_2026' with the row 'Invalid' (-1), same call at 0x142508305 under the boot Game_SaveData_DeserialiseContainer.
